= First chapter

== Repeated section

Inline `code` and a link:https://example.com/[link].

Regular prose, *bold prose*, _italic prose_, and *_nested emphasis_* exercise
style selection. The body label ⌘K and inline `⌘K` share the baseline.
Code stays upright inside _`emphasized code`_ and *`bold code`*.
